content.title: American Water Works to Merge With Essential Utilities in All-Stock Deal
content.summary: American Water Works  and  Essential Utilities  announced Monday they plan to merge in an all-stock deal that will result in a combined water-and-wastewater public utility valued at roughly $40 billion.  The combined company will have an enterprise value of approximately $63 billion, based on Friday’s closing prices.  It will continue to use the name “American Water,” with operations spanning 17 states, the companies said.
